description: Terms that MUST NOT be used in current-model prose, code identifiers, or UI copy when referring to v1 core concepts. cotest scanner greps downstream prose and source for these terms and flags occurrences outside allowed_contexts.

rejection_levels.hard_reject: MUST NOT appear in current normative prose, current SDK / service code identifiers, or current UI copy describing v1 core model.
rejection_levels.migration_only: MAY appear in clearly-marked migration documentation referencing legacy state.
rejection_levels.compat_only: Allowed only in interop / compatibility documentation.
rejection_levels.docs_only: Removed from current normative prose; survives in CHANGELOG / glossary deprecation notes.

allowed_context_definitions.changelog: Reference in CHANGELOG or migration documentation.
allowed_context_definitions.legacy_migration: Reference in dated migration guides describing legacy state.
allowed_context_definitions.interop_module: Reference in interop binding documentation (e.g., MIMI / Matrix interop).
allowed_context_definitions.negative_test: Reference in negative fixtures / cotest drift tests.

entries.notes: Contrix is the legacy brand name (lowercase `contrix`, wire prefixes `cx.` / `cx:`). Use Cokret / cokret / `ck.` / `ck:` in all current prose, identifiers, file names, and UI copy. See renames.json migration group brand_namespace_cx_to_ck.

Room is not the v1 core model. Use Realm (federation / identity / replication boundary), Circle (intra-Realm scoped event/message boundary; see zh/models/circle.md), Flow, or Space as applicable. 'Room' is permitted only when contrasting v1 with Matrix in interop documentation.
List-shaped containers are Spaces, not Realms. Realm remains the boundary concept; container shape (board / list / etc.) lives on Space.
Branch terminology was removed across Flow. Use track (display-only segment identifier). Variable / field names containing 'flow_branch' MUST be renamed.

entries.replacement: Realm members (or Circle members, when Flow.scope_circle_id points at a Circle)
entries.notes: Track does not carry independent membership; the entire Flow shares one effective scope (Flow.scope_circle_id). UI copy and docs MUST refer to Realm members or Circle members (per zh/models/circle.md). A Flow needing its own membership boundary MUST set scope_circle_id to point at an intra-Realm Circle; per-track membership boundaries do not exist.

entries.replacement: Realm history visibility / discoverability / join rule
entries.notes: Visibility is split in v1 into three independent axes: Discoverability, Join Rule, History Visibility (see spec-map 3.4). 'Room visibility' conflates them and MUST NOT be used.

Place was the pre-inversion container-shape model name. After the Realm/Space inversion the container model is Space (board / list / etc.) and the security boundary is Realm. 'Place' MUST NOT appear as a core model name in current normative prose, SDK identifiers, or UI copy. Existing zh prose still mentioning 'Place' MUST be migrated to 'Space (container)'.

Use 'External Collaboration Realm' (the role defined in zh/models/realm-and-space.md §2.7). The sovereign-deployment policy bundle that historically motivated the 'Controlled' prefix is now expressed as 'in sovereign deployment, External Collaboration Realm MUST satisfy …' and lives in zh/sync/sovereign-deployment.md §4 under ck.profile.sovereign_deployment.v1; it is not a Realm subtype. The infrastructure-isolation pattern 'Controlled Collaboration Enclave' is a separate, unchanged concept.

Chinese form of 'Controlled Collaboration Realm'; use 'External Collaboration Realm' per zh/models/realm-and-space.md §2.7. The strict sovereign-deployment policy previously implied by '受控' is now stated as a deployment-profile requirement on External Collaboration Realm in zh/sync/sovereign-deployment.md §4.

entries.replacement: Collaboration Realm / Internal Collaboration Realm / External Collaboration Realm（视语境而定）
entries.notes: The bare phrase '协作 Realm' was used historically with two distinct meanings: (a) in identity / consent / profile chapters, contrasting with Principal Control Realm — replace with 'Collaboration Realm'; (b) in sovereign-deployment / architecture chapters, implicitly meaning a cross-trust-domain Realm — replace with 'External Collaboration Realm'. Bare '协作 Realm' is docs_only (kept in CHANGELOG / migration prose) because the phrase still reads naturally as a descriptive Chinese noun phrase; for new normative content, use the precise category from realm-and-space.md §2.7. Compound descriptive uses (e.g. '大型协作 Realm', '多方协作 Realm') are unaffected by this entry — they describe a Realm's scale or membership shape, not the Realm category.
Legacy Contrix wire namespace prefix. Current Cokret v1 canonical event/profile names use ck.; cx. may appear only in migration notes or negative tests.
Legacy Contrix typed-ID prefix. Current Cokret v1 typed IDs use ck:; cx: may appear only in migration notes or negative tests.

Use plaintext for unencrypted user-readable material. cleartext is a legacy synonym and MUST NOT appear in current normative prose, code comments, identifiers, or UI copy except when naming historical forbidden fields in migration or negative-test contexts.
